description: JavaScript code for managing WAN settings in a web-based device configuration UI, including functions for retrieving, updating, and validating WAN configuration data, as well as UI interactions.

methods.name: get_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful retrieval of WAN object data; initializes UI elements with fetched data.

methods.name: get_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for failed WAN object data retrieval.

methods.name: get_obj_data
methods.description: Fetches WAN object data from API.

methods.name: set_info_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful info set operation.

methods.name: set_info_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for failed info set operation; triggers logout on 403 error.

methods.name: set_info_data
methods.description: Sends updated info data to API.

methods.name: get_info_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful info get; copies data and triggers further data fetch.

methods.name: get_info_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for failed info get; triggers logout on 403 error.

methods.name: get_info_data
methods.description: Fetches info data from API.

methods.name: page_initial
methods.description: Initializes page by fetching data and setting loading state.

methods.name: wan_refresh
methods.description: Refreshes WAN data.

methods.name: save_table
methods.description: Saves current WAN configuration from UI inputs into data model.

methods.name: select_wan_name
methods.description: Handles WAN name selection change.

methods.name: select_wan_mode
methods.description: Updates WAN mode and adjusts UI accordingly.

methods.name: select_wan_proto
methods.description: Updates WAN protocol and adjusts related UI elements.

methods.name: select_wan_dial
methods.description: Updates dial mode and adjusts UI elements based on connection type.

methods.name: select_wan_802
methods.description: Updates VLAN priority.

methods.name: select_wan_service
methods.description: Updates WAN service type.

methods.name: switch_toggle
methods.description: Toggles switch states and updates data model.

methods.name: switch_radio
methods.description: Handles radio button selection and updates data model and UI.

methods.name: layout_init
methods.description: Initializes UI layout based on WAN data.

methods.name: vlan_rule_validation
methods.description: Validates VLAN ID rules to prevent conflicts.

methods.name: valid_local_ip_rule
methods.description: Checks if two IPs are in the same subnet.

methods.name: Validatemask
methods.description: Validates IPv4 subnet mask format.

methods.name: static_rule_validation
methods.description: Validates static IP configuration rules.

methods.name: page_save
methods.description: Saves current configuration after validation.

methods.name: WanUp
methods.description: Brings WAN interface up.

methods.name: WanDown
methods.description: Brings WAN interface down.

methods.name: set_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback after successful object set; updates local data copy.

methods.name: set_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Callback after failed object set.

methods.name: set_obj_data
methods.description: Sends configuration data to API.

methods.name: loading_wait
methods.description: Displays loading progress indicator.
